findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Observed the service door to the back stock room to have a large gap at the bottom and areas along the door where weather strip is missing where daylight is clearly observed. 6-202.15: 
(A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.
Repair or replace weather stripping and varmint guards on the double door to the back storage area to discourage the entrance of insects and rodents.

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment: Observed orange juice, tea that require refrigeration to be stored in a cooler that is not functioning. There is a ticket in on this unit but the unit is only marked for milk for sale from the back and not marked that the items in the cooler are not for sale. The unit should not be holding potentially hazardous foods or it should be marked and access should be restricted. 750-140 All refrigeration units used to store potentially hazardous foods shall be able to maintain proper product temperature at 41°F or below.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Bottom of cold drink cooler is soiled. Clean and keep clean. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed a box of single use plated to be on the floor as a set up for sale. Elevate plates. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: Women's rest room has been out of order for a week and a half. An order has been placed for repair but no date has been set. Provide working restroom. 750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleansable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - Shelving and bottom inside coolers were soiled with general debris in cooler sections where gallon milk jugs are located.

Clean the shelving and the bottom inside coolers and freezers as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
